environment.description: Terraform provider runs on a shared CI/CD runner (Ubuntu 22.04, multi-tenant Jenkins agent) where multiple build jobs from different teams execute concurrently. The /tmp directory is a shared tmpfs mount with no per-user namespacing. No filesystem isolation (no private /tmp via systemd PrivateTmp). The runner has 4+ concurrent Terraform plan/apply operations from different security contexts. No seccomp or AppArmor profiles restrict file operations.
